result.topic_en: Gauss defines, for odd numbers a and b, the sum (a,b) of the integer parts [jb/a + 1/2] for j = 0 to (a-1)/2, and states its symmetry and its behaviour under b → b+ak and b → ak−b, also in terms of an auxiliary function f(a,b).
result.transcription:
#d [?] Math 13 ) positiv [?] [-43c-] 71 [?] (40)
Es seien $a, b$ zwei ungerade Zahlen
und man bezeichne durch $(a,b)$ die Summe

$[0+\frac{1}{2}] + [\frac{b}{a}+\frac{1}{2}] + [\frac{2b}{a}+\frac{1}{2}] + [\frac{3b}{a}+\frac{1}{2}]$
$+ \text{etc.} + [\frac{\frac{1}{2}(a-1)b}{a}+\frac{1}{2}]$

Man hat dann

I) $(a,b) = (b,a)$
II $(a, b+ak) = (a,b) + \frac{1}{8}(aa-1)k$
III $(a, ak-b) = $ [-a-] [?] $\frac{1}{8}(aa-1)k - (a,b)$
Noch einfacher wenn man obiges
$(a,b) = \frac{1}{8}ab$ [?] $\frac{1}{8}f(a,b)$ setzt
man hat dass $(a, b$ ungerade$)$
$f(a,b) = f(b,a)$
$f(a, ak+b) = f(a,b) + $ [-?-] $k$
$f(a, ak-b) = f$ [-?-] $k - f(a,b)$

methods.what: Definition of the bracket symbol (a,b) for odd a, b as a sum of rounded multiples (integer parts)
Translation rule for the second argument
Reflection rule for the second argument
Substitution (a,b) = ab/8 ± f(a,b)/8 and the corresponding simplified rules for f
Translation and reflection rules for f
